title: Hosted API validation gates and deploy sanity playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Define a compact, testable set of validation gates and a deploy sanity playbook that the Hosted API and Console teams can follow for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank endpoints. This ticket captures requirements, acceptance criteria, gated rollout plan, and operational runbook checks to reduce regression risk while enabling faster progressive launches.
goals: Ensure behavioral parity for generation, embeddings, and reranking across regions and model variants
Provide deterministic pass/fail criteria for canary and staged rollouts
Surface telemetry and SLO checks that must pass before automated promotion
Document emergency rollback and mitigation steps for user-visible regressions or reliability incidents
out_of_scope: New API surface design changes (protocol-level changes)
Major runtime kernel optimizations — performance tuning handled in separate ENG tickets
scope_included: Endpoint-specific behavioral tests for chat (multi-turn), completions (prompt->single response), embeddings (vector correctness and dimensionality), and rerank (score stability)
Canary gating rules (traffic % thresholds, time windows, error/bias monitors)
Sanity checks for streaming, function-calling hooks, and structured output fields
Operational checks: logging, traces, token-level cost breakdown visibility, and quota enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Automated canary test suite runs in CI against staging models and returns <1% critical failures for 72h at 5% traffic
Generation quality baseline: response length distribution and perplexity within defined deltas compared to control model
Embeddings baseline: cosine similarity on anchor dataset must be >= 0.98 relative to control and dimensionality/shape validated
Rerank baseline: NDCG@10 improvement check and deterministic ranking for canonical inputs
Latency SLO: p95 single-token latency <= 120ms for standard model class in eu-west-1 under canary load profile
Cost signal: per-token unit cost does not exceed 1.25x of pinned target without prior approval
Security checks: KMS key binding verified for Private deployments and audit logs flowing to SIEM for hosted runs
Observability: Console dashboard shows token-level cost, per-route error budget, and sample request traces for canary cohort
Fallbacks: automatic routing to next-compatible model variant engages below configured health thresholds and preserves API contract
Manual sign-off: PM + Engineering lead + SRE must sign before full traffic promotion; signatures stored in release doc
canary_and_rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Smoke): Deploy to internal staging; run end-to-end smoke tests (sanity tests + auth + quotas) - 2 hours
Phase 1 (Canary): 5% prod traffic for 72 hours; run continuous canary suite and telemetry guardrails
Phase 2 (Ramp): 20% for 48 hours with expanded demographic traffic; pay attention to region-specific SLOs
Phase 3 (Full): 100% with monitoring retention and post-launch 72h war-room on standby
Promotion gating: automated promote if canary pass rate >99% and no critical alerts; otherwise hold and run diagnostics
rollout_checklist: Create release note draft with behavioral changes and known limitations
PR reviewed and merged for API surface and server-side compatibility tests
Canary job scheduled in infra with proper traffic shaping and tagging
Observability: dashboards created and validated, with alert thresholds copied to channel #hosted-canary
Quality: canonical prompt set and embedding anchor datasets uploaded to test runner
Security: KMS and audit logging configuration verified by Security
Legal & Privacy: Data retention and telemetry sampling rates confirmed
Support: playbook and FAQ stub added to Support Confluence; paging rotations notified
Backout: rollback runbook validated in staging and rehearsed once with SRE
Postmortem template prepared and owner identified
operational_runbook_snippets: If canary error rate spikes >0.5% absolute in a 15m rolling window: pause promotion and triage via #incident-hosted
If generation quality metric deviation >threshold: collect sample requests and open a quality regression ticket linking this key
For increased cost signal (>1.5x expected): automatically throttle batch sizes for new model variant and alert cost-ops
Manual rollback: trigger previous stable model tag and confirm route changes across regions; validate traces and sampling after rollback
notifications_and_comms: Create canary announcement on #releases 24h before Phase 1
Schedule 2h launch readiness review with PM/Eng/SRE/Support day-of
Open a persistent status thread in #hosted-canary during rollout
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: subtle quality regressions that automated metrics miss -> Mitigation: manual prompt review panel and flagged sample collection
Risk: region-specific infra degradation -> Mitigation: limit per-region ramp and pre-validate regional infra health
Risk: telemetry gaps during high load -> Mitigation: preflight end-to-end synthetic trace with real token counts before canary
